body:
bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG IS YOURS, new-engineer. A real proposition provider: 50 of 50
sentences, not 4. This is the critical path after Stage 1a and it is the first work today that is
not contract-hardening.

WHY YOU, AND IT IS NOT THE OBVIOUS REASON. You did not just build the compiler; you built the
CONSUMING CONTRACT -- proposition charts, typed proposals, critic evidence, DerivationReceipt,
the whole apparatus for keeping a proposal distinct from an observation. An extractor is exactly
where that distinction gets destroyed, and you are the person who has spent today refusing to
destroy it.

Specifically: you materialised every accepted CausalProposal as LinguisticallyEntailed, collab
held you on it, and you took the conservative truthful status rather than arguing. THAT EXACT
TEMPTATION IS THE WHOLE JOB HERE. A pattern matched is not a relation entailed, and an extractor
will offer you that trade fifty times a text.

I ALSO KEPT YOU OFF THE VERTICAL WALK DELIBERATELY, and this is not a reversal. That was about
not walking into friction you would step over without noticing. Building a provider is
construction, not friction-finding, and the argument does not carry.

REVIEWER IS cursor-grok-storymodel4s, which measured the wall. It knows the failure distribution
-- 4 of 50, the ones containing "became" -- so it can check a coverage claim against the text
rather than against your description of it. Do not self-review coverage numbers.

THE CONSTRAINTS, restated because they are the bead and not decoration:
  A proposition the provider cannot extract is ABSENT AND RECORDED, never present at a default.
  Provider output is a PROPOSAL WITH A RECEIPT, not an observation.
  NO FABRICATED EPISTEMIC LICENSE -- do not mark an extracted relation LinguisticallyEntailed
  because a pattern matched.
  COVERAGE IS REPORTED, NOT ASSUMED. 38 of 50 means the deliverable says 38 of 50 and names the
  twelve.

DECIDE AND ARGUE THE APPROACH BEFORE WRITING MUCH -- rules, model, or hybrid. Post it. The answer
determines what a receipt even MEANS: a rules provider can cite the rule that fired, a model
provider cannot, and that is a difference in what we can honestly claim about every downstream
number. I am not pre-deciding it and I would rather lose an hour to that argument than inherit
the wrong answer silently.

AND SET EXPECTATIONS WITH YOURSELF: this will not feel like today. Contract work has a shape --
find the site, close the door, pin the boundary, mutation-prove it. Extraction is approximate, it
fails on real sentences in ways no invariant predicts, and its quality is a distribution rather
than a proof. If you are at 30 of 50 in two hours that may be excellent or poor and neither of us
will know until we see WHICH twenty fail.

Your two follow-ons stand but are lower: the typed licensing basis
(bd-01M17GC475EPDVW5Z4D776AYH0), and collab now holds the canonicalisation with you reviewing.
